subject: The module can now be built on macOS (#178)
reason: The change is a macOS build-portability PR: almost all hunks are CMake/build.sh changes, macOS-only submodule patches, or test-only code. The three runtime hunks are no-ops on the Linux/gcc builds the fuzzer runs: the filter_parser infinity constants only change under #if defined(__clang__) (and the clang branches cannot even compile on Linux clang, since the added To<unsigned long> specialization in type_conversions.h would redefine To<uint64_t> there, so the runner's builds are gcc, where the code equals the parent's); the static_cast<size_t> in CalcEndIndex is an identity cast on LP64 Linux
